_original_lore: The Professor is the boss of Floor 3 of the Catacombs.
He is a 'Professor' and has three phases. In the 1st he
spawns 4 Guardians and creates a barrier. After they are
killed, he attacks the player. Once he is at 25% health,
he will merge with his guardians and continue to fight.
name: 教授 (首领)

source: The Professor is the boss of Floor {{N0}} of the Catacombs.
